reviews.author: JANE CROSKEY
reviews.text: I highly recommend!!  Beautiful job, cleaned with a protective covering.. She even cleaned and sanitized the mattress inside my sofa sleeper. Reliable and professional.  She (Mariana) moved furniture and cleaned up after herself.   One woman small business owner. 👍. She uses your fabric information for the perfect cleaning ingredient solution.  Sofa sleeper, love  seat with matching throw pillows.  In less than 2 hours.  Only takes 3 hours to dry.

reviews.author: Kristina Gorelova
reviews.text:
I’m very happy with the service! They cleaned my sofa and upholstered dining chairs, and everything looks great.The technician was professional, friendly, and explained everything clearly. They arrived on time, and the work was completed exactly as promised.
I was also surprised to see how much hidden dust and dirt came out of my furniture during the cleaning process. It really showed me how important professional cleaning is.
I’m very satisfied with the results and would definitely recommend this company to others. Thank you for excellent service!

reviews.author: Sean DeMartino
reviews.text: Amazing! Our couches look SO good and back to their brand new feeling after our dogs took them over for a few months. Job well done.

reviews.author: Ezmariyah Jesel
reviews.text: Great job cleaning the couch for a good price and even offered to clean my chairs. Was timely and very professional! Would definitely hire again for future cleanings

reviews.author: Iryna Lutsenko
reviews.text: Great experience with Allstar Upholstery Cleaning! They did an amazing job cleaning my sectional sofa. It looks fresh, clean, and almost like new again. Professional, reliable, and easy to work with. Highly recommend their services!👌
